sloka: यानि पश्यन्ति काकुत्स्थं स्थावराणि चराणि च ।सर्वाणि रामगमने ह्यनुजग्मुर्हि तान्यपि ।। ७.१०९.२१ ॥
transliteration: yāni paśyanti kākutsthaṁ sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ।sarvāṇi rāmagamane hyanujagmurhi tānyapi ।। 7.109.21 ॥

translations.english: All beings, both immobile and mobile, that beheld Rama, indeed followed him at his departure.
